hooks.name: Spec sync reminder
hooks.description: When Kiro edits a models.py file, prints which design.md Data Models section must be updated so specs and code never drift apart. Command action: no credits.

action.command: app=$(grep -oE '(intake|autopsy|specgen|parity)/models\.py' | head -1 | cut -d/ -f1); if [ -n "$app" ]; then echo "Spec sync: $app/models.py changed. Update the Data Models section of the matching design.md in .kiro/specs/ (spec-generator for specgen, project-skeleton or $app for the others)."; fi
